name: Memories of a Home
source:
A daughter searches for her missing father, with echoes and hauntings of Japanese American WWII incarceration.

A journaling horror visual novel, based in the late 1950s after WWII, the Executive Order 9066 ordered Japanese American Incarceration may echo in some of the character's, memory. 

“If the walls could talk,” they always said. But you know better. In the late hours, during the absolute darkness, the walls will open their maws and whisper their secrets, shared through cries and wails and mimicry of the horrors within. You’re a private investigator with the unique talent of teasing out their mysteries and piecing together their meanings.

This is a journaling VN about the knowledge of the walls.

As you move through locations, you’ll be directed to prompts to write as the P.I. trying to solve a mystery. Throughout the game, you’ll move through encounters to learn what the walls, ceiling and floors are telling or showing you, you will keep notes in a journal in the game on what you think it all means and ultimately conclude the truth from your notes.

There are many different encounters in the locations and you only encounter a fraction of them In each game. So, you can start a new game to get a different set of encounters and endings.

More historical information on Japanese American incarceration during WWII and the mandatory resettlement and life afterwards is available on the [url=https://www.fullspectrum.education/resettlement/demo]Resettlement[/url] film site.

This game is based on the TTRPG [url=https://pandiongames.itch.io/whispers-in-the-walls]Whispers in the Walls[/url] by [url=https://pandiongames.com/products/the-whispers-in-the-walls]PANDION GAMES[/url].

[From [url=https://kindeyegames.itch.io/witw-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名女儿寻找失踪的父亲，二战期间日裔美国人遭拘禁的往事，如幽灵般回荡。

这是一部以日记记录为玩法的恐怖视觉小说，背景设在二战结束后的20世纪50年代末。第9066号行政命令所导致的日裔美国人拘禁经历，或许仍在某些角色的记忆中回响。

“要是墙壁会说话就好了。”人们总这么说。但你知道得更清楚。深夜，万籁俱寂、一片漆黑之时，墙壁会张开大口，低声吐露秘密，用哭喊、哀号，以及对屋内恐怖景象的模仿来诉说。你是一名私家侦探，拥有独特的天赋，能引出这些谜团，并拼凑出它们的含义。

这是一部关于墙壁所知之事、需要记日记的视觉小说。

在各个地点移动时，游戏会给出写作提示，让你以正在破案的私家侦探身份记录。你将经历种种遭遇，了解墙壁、天花板和地板在诉说或展示什么，在游戏内的日记中记下自己的理解，最终根据笔记推导出真相。

每个地点都有许多不同的遭遇，每次游玩只会遇见其中一部分。因此，你可以重新开始游戏，体验不同的遭遇与结局。

关于二战期间日裔美国人遭拘禁、被迫迁居及其后生活的更多历史资料，可参阅电影[url=https://www.fullspectrum.education/resettlement/demo]《Resettlement》[/url]的网站。

本作改编自[url=https://pandiongames.com/products/the-whispers-in-the-walls]PANDION GAMES[/url]的桌面角色扮演游戏[url=https://pandiongames.itch.io/whispers-in-the-walls]《Whispers in the Walls》[/url]。

[摘自[url=https://kindeyegames.itch.io/witw-vn]itch.io[/url]]
